This sheet is UI equipment icons, NOT perspective objects: all badges, shirts and flags are flat FRONT VIEW. Four rows correspond to FOUR distinct original fictional clubs. Each row: column1 original heraldic club badge; column2 home jersey FRONT ONLY (shirt, no shorts or wearer); column3 away jersey FRONT ONLY; column4 supporter flag in matching club colors with the same emblem. Tiny crests on shirts must match their row. All garments complete, no text, letters, numbers, sponsor or brand.
ROW1 Aurora Atlético: navy and amber. Shield with amber rising sun above small stylized football. Home navy shirt, amber collar/cuffs and narrow amber chest band. Away cream shirt with navy shoulders and amber collar. Navy flag with amber sun shield.
ROW2 União Ferroviária: burgundy and cream. Diamond badge with cream railway wheel and rail lines. Home burgundy and cream vertical stripes. Away cream shirt with single burgundy diagonal sash. Burgundy flag with cream railway badge.
ROW3 EC Horizonte: forest green and white. Circular badge with a white horizon arch and small rising sun. Home green shirt with white sleeve cuffs. Away white shirt with green broad chest band. Green flag with white round badge.
ROW4 Atlético Ribeirense: red and black. Angular shield with silver river wave and small football. Home red-black horizontal hoops. Away light gray shirt with red-black collar and sleeve ends. Red-black flag with matching river shield.
Maintain identical shirt scale across all eight kits; no humans, hanger, mockup, or fabric photography.
